description: This file defines a Fragment that demonstrates the use of the Camera2 API in Android to capture RAW and JPEG photos. It manages camera setup, permissions, preview, capture sequences, and background saving of images. It includes functionality for auto-focus, auto-exposure, white balance, orientation handling, and image saving, optimized for RAW and JPEG outputs.

classes.description: Dialog fragment to show errors, terminates activity on acknowledgment.

classes.description: A wrapper that manages reference counting of AutoCloseable objects to handle resource cleanup.
